terms.gloss: feel, perceive (with the senses or the mind)
terms.comment: With an accusative (frīgus sentīre) or an accusative and infinitive (sentiō aperīrī forēs, I hear the door opening). Feelings are mostly said with other verbs: doleō, it hurts, I’m sorry; gaudeō, I’m glad.

phrases.latin: sollicitāque manū tenebrās explōrat inertēs vestīgatque focum, laesus quem dēnique sēnsit
phrases.english: with an anxious hand he gropes through the darkness and feels for the hearth, which in the end he found when it burned him
she feels both sadness and joy (of a little dog)
